decision_reason: NASA identifies Glenn Flux Reconstruction (GFR) as a significant NASA Glenn CFD code and the public repository exposes substantial Fortran source, sample cases, and technical documentation. NASA's current GFR page and 2025 NTRS paper show continuing research activity, but the repository has no LICENSE file or exact grant text; its README's statement that it was approved for an open-source release is not a substitute for the applicable code grant. The public repository last changed in 2018 while the 2025 paper reports later capabilities, so it is not clear that the paper or current support refers to the exact public source snapshot. Hold pending exact license text and source-version parity/current distribution evidence.
